figurative_meaning_en: Deep or grave voice; implying an attempt to sound authoritative or serious without substance
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গলা ভারী করে কথা বলে যেন খুব গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ব্যক্তি।
বক্তৃতায় গলা ভারী করলেও তার কথায় ওজন নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He speaks with a heavy voice as if he is a very important person.
Even with a heavy voice in the speech, his words lack weight.
note: The idiom often highlights the futility of superficial attempts to appear important.
